⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Marks a chunk as an independent seek target.

A seekable chunk can be handed to the decoder without replaying any
earlier chunk. Default is true for codecs whose segments are always
self-contained (e.g. Opus); codecs with inter-frame dependencies should
set this false on non-key segments.
